title: Amadeus: Rebook Partial Pax (Priority Floor Case)
scenario: Rebook 2 ADT out of 3 ADT in 1 PNR, round-trip, outbound flown (F), return open (O)
branch: ATC errors on used segment → Switch to Manual FQP calculation
Coupon status != O → Route to Coupon Status Branch / Airline queue
Phone voluntary on issued ticket → Mandatory Edvin Email Verification Gate
Customer selects MOTO vs Payment Link (30-min validity)

steps.title: Split PNR First (Automation does not auto-split)
steps.desc: Retrieve the shared booking. Split off the 2 passengers who are changing dates, then save and retrieve the newly generated split PNR.
steps.notes: Original PNR stays untouched for the 1 ADT keeping their original flight date. Work the remaining rebooking steps solely on the split-off PNR.

steps.title: Coupon Status & Eligibility Verification
steps.desc: Display the electronic ticket image and inspect coupon status per segment.
steps.notes: Outbound must show status F (Flown). Return must show status O (Open). Only Open/Airport Control coupons can be rebooked. If status is C/E/S, stop and request airline reopen.

steps.title: Sell New Return Flight Segment(s)
steps.desc: Check flight availability for the requested new return date and sell the replacement segment(s) for the 2 passengers.
steps.notes: Keep segment status SS. Do not cancel the old return segment until the new one is priced and agreed.

steps.title: Price Calculation: Try ATC first → Fall back to Manual FQP
steps.desc: Attempt ATC pricing. Since the outbound leg is already flown, ATC may fail with class or history mismatch. If so, switch to manual FQP calculation.
steps.notes: Calculate Ticket Difference + Tax Difference. Compare new manual fare mask against original e-ticket. Do NOT reprice the flown leg as unused.

steps.title: Mandatory Email Verification Gate
steps.desc: For phone interactions on voluntary changes to an issued ticket, verify the customer's email address in Edvin before collecting payment.
steps.cmd: Edvin ► Verify email button ► Confirm matching registered email
steps.notes: Mandatory gate! Always correspond exclusively with the email address registered in Edvin.

steps.title: ETG Service Fee & Payment Collection (MOTO / PL)
steps.desc: Add Our Service Fee - Vol. Rebooking (40 EUR/pax standard or market equivalent; waived for Booking.com/Platinum/Business). Collect via MOTO or send Payment Link.
steps.cmd: Total = Airline Fare Diff + Airline Penalty + ETG Rebooking Fee (x2 pax) → Edvin Add-on Purchase
steps.notes: MOTO completes charge on call. Payment Link is strictly valid for 30 minutes for rebooking. Shorten if ticketing deadline is sooner.

steps.title: Clean Segments & End Transaction
steps.desc: Once payment is verified, cancel the old unused return segment and save the PNR with end-transaction entries.
steps.notes: Ensure status is HK for new segments and old segments are removed.

steps.title: Handoff: Rebooking Wizard (NOT Modify Order)
steps.desc: Link the split PNR in Edvin and submit via Rebooking Wizard to the Ticketing queue for ticket reissue.
steps.cmd: Edvin > Link PNR → Rebooking Wizard (Voluntary Rebooking) → Route to Ticketing → Order Status: Changed
steps.notes: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Modify Order! Modify Order is strictly for cancellations/refunds. Rebooking without refund MUST go through Rebooking Wizard.

source: Manual Rebooking Amadeus; 2. Partially used ticket; Section 1: Split a Reservation; 00. Rebooking fees & commands — cheat

title: Amadeus: Rebook Fully Unused Ticket (ATC Flow)
scenario: Customer wants to rebook an unused ticket in Amadeus using automated ATC
branch: ATC successful → Save TST and proceed to payment
ATC failed → Switch to manual calculation FQP
Within 24h void window → Offer Void & Rebook if cheaper

steps.title: Open PNR & Check Coupon Status
steps.desc: Retrieve PNR, verify segment is HK, and check ticket coupons are O (Open).
steps.notes: Confirm no Schedule Change (UN/TK) is pending.

steps.title: Book New Segments
steps.desc: Check availability and sell new segment(s) for all passengers.
steps.notes: Keep old segments until price is calculated and agreed.

steps.title: Calculate Fare with ATC
steps.desc: Run automated pricing to generate quote and new TST mask.
steps.notes: Note airline fare difference and penalty. Deduct change fee manually if customer has Flexible Ticket product.

steps.title: Verify Email Gate & Collect Payment
steps.desc: Run Edvin Verify Email check if phone call. Collect fare difference + ETG service fee via MOTO or 30-min Payment Link.
steps.cmd: Edvin Verify Email → Add-on Purchase → MOTO or PL
steps.notes: No service fee for Booking.com or Platinum orders.

steps.title: Cancel Old Segments & Route to Rebooking Wizard
steps.desc: Cancel old segments and queue to Ticketing via Rebooking Wizard.
steps.notes: Always use Rebooking Wizard for ticket reissue.

title: Sabre: Rebook Partial Pax / Partially Used Ticket
scenario: Split partial pax in Sabre and reprice partially used ticket
branch: Confirm PCC matches ticket issuing office via *S / AAA[PCC]
Automated reissue unavailable for partially used → Manual WFRTR

steps.title: Check PCC & Split Reservation in Sabre
steps.desc: Verify current PCC with *S (switch with AAA[PCC] if needed). Split the changing passenger(s).
steps.notes: Retrieve the split-off PNR using *D.

steps.title: Check Coupon STAT and BAG Allowance
steps.desc: Open ticket image to verify coupon status is OPEN or ACTRL.
steps.notes: Note baggage allowance shown next to fare to maintain same allowance.

steps.title: Sell New Flight Segments
steps.desc: Check Sabre availability and sell new flight segment(s).
steps.notes: Segment status will be SS.

steps.title: Reprice Unused Segment (Manual WFRTR)
steps.desc: Run manual reprice mask for unused segment(s) on partially used ticket.
steps.notes: Read EQV/BASE for new fare, MD for old tax, add penalty from AFTER DEPARTURE section.

steps.title: Retain Transaction & Clean Segments
steps.desc: Save the retained mask, delete old segments, sign and end transaction.
steps.notes: Sys Msg: TRANSACTION RETAINED.

steps.title: Email Gate, Payment & Rebooking Wizard
steps.desc: Verify email in Edvin, collect payment (Airline Diff + Fee), submit to Rebooking Wizard.
steps.cmd: Edvin Verify Email → Collect MOTO/PL → Rebooking Wizard → Ticketing Queue
steps.notes: Do not use Modify Order.

source: Manual Rebooking Sabre; Cheatsheet: Rebooking (Amadeus & Sabre)

title: Amadeus/Sabre: Cancel Partial Pax in Void Window
scenario: Cancel only some passengers within same-day void window
branch: Automation does not split → Split manually first
Infant linked to cancelled pax → Escalate to Support before proceeding
Order status set to Changed, NOT Cancelled

steps.title: Split PNR Manually
steps.desc: Automation void will fail on partial pax. Split the cancelling passengers into a new PNR.
steps.notes: Do not void the shared booking directly.

steps.title: Cancel Segments & Void Ticket on Split PNR
steps.desc: Add ghost line, cancel segments on split PNR, and void the tickets.
steps.notes: Verify coupon status updates to V (Voided).

steps.title: Link Split PNR in Edvin
steps.desc: Link the new PNR to the order in Edvin so the split is tracked.
steps.cmd: Edvin > Link PNR → Enter new PNR locator
steps.notes: Crucial step so refunds and ticketing can trace the booking.

steps.title: Modify Order → Void
steps.desc: Run Modify Order with reason 'Void' on the split PNR only.
steps.cmd: Modify Order → Reason: Void → Status: Changed
steps.notes: Set order status to 'Changed' (NOT 'Cancelled') since remaining pax are still flying.

source: 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat; 1. Cancellation within the Void period

title: GDS Cancellation: Voluntary (Fare Rules Penalty)
scenario: Voluntary cancellation outside void/24h window according to fare rules
branch: Refundable w/ penalty → Modify Order: Ticket rules - airline fee
Tax only refund → Modify Order: Ticket rules - taxes
No-show passed → Apply higher of cancellation vs no-show penalty

steps.title: Check Fare Rules & Penalties
steps.desc: Read fare penalty Category 16 (PE) in GDS to determine cancellation penalty.
steps.notes: Determine whether fare is Non-refundable, Refundable with penalty, or Tax-only.

steps.title: Quote Net Refund to Customer
steps.desc: Convert penalty to customer currency, calculate: Net Refund = Ticket Fare & Taxes - Airline Penalty - ETG Service Fee.
steps.cmd: Quote Breakdown: Airline Refund - ETG Voluntary CXL Service Fee
steps.notes: No ETG service fee on Booking.com / Business / Platinum.

steps.title: Confirm Explicit Customer Agreement
steps.desc: Wait for clear verbal agreement before cancelling any flights in GDS or running Modify Order.
steps.cmd: Speak Agreement Cue: 'The total refund after airline penalty and fees is... do you confirm?'
steps.notes: Do not cancel without explicit customer consent.

steps.title: Cancel Segments in GDS
steps.desc: Cancel the flight segments in GDS and add ghost retention line.
steps.notes: Keep PNR alive with retention line.

steps.title: Run Modify Order in Edvin
steps.desc: Run Modify Order with reason 'Ticket rules - airline fee' or 'Ticket rules - taxes'.
steps.cmd: Modify Order → Reason: Ticket rules - airline fee → Zendesk Apply Macro → Refunds
steps.notes: Routes errand to SL Refunds queue for payout processing.

source: Study Guide — CC Amadeus Cancellations; 00. Cancellation & Void — cheat

title: GDS Ancillaries: Paid Seat / Baggage (EMD)
scenario: Add paid baggage or seating requiring EMD issuance
branch: SSR confirmed HK → Proceed to charge
SSR unconfirmed / NO FARE → Refer customer to airline
Customer declines → Remove SSR with XE immediately

steps.title: Open Catalog & Add SSR
steps.desc: Check ancillary catalog or seat map and add the SSR entry.
steps.notes: Round-trip requires adding baggage for each segment separately.

steps.title: Confirm SSR Status is HK
steps.desc: Check AES to confirm airline returned HK status before attempting to charge.
steps.notes: Do NOT charge customer before SSR status is HK!

steps.title: Charge Customer in Edvin
steps.desc: Charge via Add-on purchases in Edvin selecting Baggage GDS / Seating GDS.
steps.cmd: Edvin ► Add-on purchases ► Select product ► MOTO / PL
steps.notes: Payment link valid 48h for ancillaries (shorten if departure is sooner).

steps.title: Register Errand & Place on Ticketing Queue
steps.desc: Register errand with template 'TKT info EMD Ancillary' and queue to BOM TKT / UPA TKT.
steps.cmd: Template: TKT info EMD Ancillary → Queue: BOM TKT / UPA TKT – Ancillary post sales
steps.notes: Ticketing team issues the EMD.

source: 3. Ancillaries step by step guidelines; 2. How to add ancillaries
